syncEdges.note: gRPC: geo.NewGeoClient (server.go:101), Geo.Nearby call (server.go:136, proto geo.proto:9); dialled with grpc.Dial (dialer/dialer.go:55). Callee is the Consul service name passed to the dialer; compose key is geo (docker-compose.yml:81).
gRPC: rate.NewRateClient (server.go:110), Rate.GetRates call (server.go:149, proto rate.proto:9). Callee is the Consul service name; compose key is rate (docker-compose.yml:102).

container.note: No container_name in the search block (docker-compose.yml:61-79); the compose service key is used as the name. The search block has no healthcheck: key (docker-compose.yml:61-79) and the harness overlay has none for search (compose.observability-placement.yml:12-16). Absence of a health check: compose default, not in these files.

replicas.note: Overlay does not set replicas for search.

registersWith.note: Registration call at services/search/server.go:82 (s.Registry.Register) under the name srv-search (server.go:24). Consul agent image pinned in the overlay (compose.observability-placement.yml:3).

exportsTelemetryTo.note: Traces via jaeger-client-go (go.mod:15), agent host set from the address (tracing/tracer.go:37). BufferFlushInterval 1 s (tracer.go:36). Sample ratio default 0.01 (tracer.go:14); the overlay sets JAEGER_SAMPLE_RATIO for search to 1 by default (compose.observability-placement.yml:15).
Logs: zerolog ConsoleWriter to stdout. No log shipping and no log flush interval in these files.

name.note: Upstream image is hashicorp/consul:latest (docker-compose.yml:5); the harness overlay pins hashicorp/consul:1.13 (compose.observability-placement.yml:3).

type.note: Consul API client used by search to register (registry.go:92) and deregister (registry.go:97) its service.

hostedBy.note: Compose service whose image runs the Consul agent.

mechanism.note: One-shot registration at startup (services/search/server.go:82). AgentServiceRegistration (registry.go:85-90) has no Check or TTL field. No heartbeat loop, failure timeout or cleanup interval in these files: library default, not in these files (consul api v1.26.1, go.mod:10). Whether a heartbeat runs independently of request processing: not stated in these files.

monitors.note: Consul service name the search service is registered under (server.go:82).
